title: STEMイングリッシュ
subtitle: STEM English
courseType:
English Language Program
English Language Courses
educationalGoal: In this course, students will acquire four skills (reading, writing, speaking, and listening) using English in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM). The aim is to acquire the ability to find and solve problems in STEM fields. Find out more about the issues covered and gain the ability to communicate your opinions and ideas in English through discussions and presentations.
advice: In this course, students will gain content knowledge and apply what they have learned to solve a range of different STEM related problems. An outline of the activities is as follows. 1. Science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM) centered course 2. Content language integrated learning (CLIL) approach 3. Learn about and apply the scientific method to a range of topics 4. Plan and conduct investigations 5. Collect and analyze data from experiments 6. Report the findings from a range of STEM investigations Be sure to check e-syllabus before each class. Use English videos and related articles for teaching materials. The preparation / review includes activities other than those performed in class, such as interview activities.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic English grammar is required.

activityGoals.body: Can describe STEM issues and research methods in English.
Can analyze the issues in English.
Explain collected data and analysis results in English using graphs and diagrams.
Understand your role during activities and work on issues in teams.
Effectively report the results of activities using presentation software and present solutions.
